iterationEvidence.testRepair: Preserved exact frozen beard-only all-non-beard comparison and added current non-scalp comparison; no historical hash or geometry expectations removed

findings: Six gallery originals and six actual dossier originals inspected across desktop/mobile and dark/light; remaining 72 retained originals are explicitly uninspected.
Hairline edge is less uniform; braid paths now run from crown and loc tips are less tightly curled. Dark hair has subtle strand contrast.

Afro silhouette still reads swept/cap-like, braids remain smooth cap with thin rows, locs retain a broad cap and sparse dangling ends, and long hair remains visibly sparse. These style-recognition/naturalism defects remain open.
Face, beard and measured body remain mannequin-like; current improvement does not meet complete-person craft.
Actual dossier remains readable with shared head in front/profile/movement. Asynchronous screenshots do not prove synchronized pose equality.
All geometry and coverage thresholds remain artistic assumptions, not country/NFL prevalence or measured anatomy.
fixesApplied: Head-fixed coverage taper with opaque dense core
Reduced loose-hair width and broad fiber contrast
Crown volume and crown-to-border braid paths
Grouped grooming conceals loose texture; thicker gentle loc paths
Preserved current skin/eye/ear/beard geometry and no-scalp compiled pixels
